strongest_counterhypothesis: ordinary query-aware CognitiveView + safe decision-focused greedy cover + query-relative completeness metadata + existing selector/dependency hashes can reproduce DCA semantics with less complexity
evidence: SAFE_DECISION_COVER and DCA_SELECTION have identical 0.9743 decision certification and identical uncovered-pair rate in the 3000-case discriminator; DCA adds witness cost.
The local negative benchmark supports query-relative current completeness semantics, but it does not show that a dedicated DCA type is superior to ordinary metadata carrying the same fields.
Current G9 already contains selector_hash and dependency_hash, reducing the need for new runtime machinery.
verdict: DCA is refuted as a distinct selector/runtime structure. Retain only the typed model-boundary candidate until a mutation/non-bypass test distinguishes it from the conventional metadata bundle.
kill_next: If matched target/compiler mutations show the conventional metadata bundle rejects the same unsafe absence/omission/stale mutants with equal false-positive rate and lower implementation complexity, kill DCA completely.
